THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON
WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4 (1) of the Industrial Disputes Act Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (Revised
Edition 1956) as amended by Acts. Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with Industrial Disputes (Special Provisions)
Act No. 37 of 1968 dated 23.03.2016 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 1960/
12 dated 29.03.2016 the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour dated
Group of Employees including Mrs. S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari, Balagollagama, Balalla of the one part
Central Cultural Fund, No. 212/1, Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07 of the other part
was referred to Mr. T. E. Santharajan for settlement by arbitration.
AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, W. D. J. Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union
Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the said Order dated 23.03.2016.
Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON
WHEREAS AN industrial dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompanies this
Group of Employees including Mrs. S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari, Balagollagama, Balalla of the one part
Central Cultural Fund, No. 212/1, Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07 of the other part
NOW THEREFORE I, Welatantirige Don John Seneviratne, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers
vested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition),
as amended by Acts Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial disputes-Special Provisions) Act No. 37 of 1968 hereby
appoint Mr. T. E. Santharajan, No. 181/1, A. P. T. 503, W. A. Silva Mawatha, Colombo 06 to be the Arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute
to him for settlement by arbitration.
W. D. J. SENEVIRATNE,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Group of Employees including Mrs. S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari, Balagollagama, Balalla of the one part
Central Cultural Fund, No. 212/1, Bauddhaloka Mawatha, Colombo 07 of the other part
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is
Whether the group of employees including Mrs. S. P. Anoma Shyamali Kumari who had worked in the Post of Excavation Conservation
Assistant, in the places of worship at Yapahuwa, Dambadeniya, Ridee Viharaya (Rideegama) and Nathagane (Paduwasnuwara) of the
Vayamba Square of the Central Cultural Fund have been caused injustice by termination of their services from 02.11.2015 and if so, to what
M. D. C. AMARATUNGA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo, this 22nd day of February, 2017.
